Usage: quark-agent [OPTIONS]

Options:
  --api-key TEXT  Access key of OpenAI API
  --help          Show this message and exit.

--comparison.help: Behaviors comparison based on max confidence of rule labels

--core-library.help: Specify the core library used to analyze an APK

--detail.help: Show detail report. Optionally specify the name of a rule/label

--dynamic-resolve.help: Enable dynamic string resolution via DexTrace. Executes encrypted string methods at analysis time to recover plaintext for Phase 5 keyword matching. Requires: pip install quark-engine[dynamic].

--generate-rule.help: Generate rules and output to given directory

--graph.help: Create call graph to call_graph_image directory

--label.help: Show report based on label of rules

--summary.help: Show summary report. Optionally specify the name of a rule/label

--threshold.help: Set the lower limit of the confidence threshold
